description: California Road Sharing (CaRS) Initiative Partnerships is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. Purpose of this dataset is to show CA counties that are involved in the CaRS program. This dataset shows contact information and data partnership information from the CaRS initiative. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are Boundary, CA, CAOpenData, CaRS, CalSTA. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
